subject: Discovery recap + lock technical session
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@olivetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed technical session

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're aligned before a deeper technical session: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for conversational features and bring embeddings generation in-house for search ranking.
- Current pain: unpredictable token cost and occasional tail latency spikes under peak traffic.
- Constraints: HIPAA-adjacent data handling, prefer SSO + VPC options for production.

Suggested next step: 60-minute technical deep dive with engineering and infra owners to walk through a POC plan and capacity/architecture implications. Proposed slots (all ET):
- Wed Jul 21, 2027 — 10:00–11:00 ET
- Thu Jul 22, 2027 — 15:00–16:00 ET

Could you confirm which slot works and who from OliveTech should join (engineering + security/ops)? We generally run these as a Google Meet unless you prefer Zoom.

I attached a short mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines scope, stakeholders, and a suggested timeline — useful for the meeting.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood-MAP-v1.1.pdf (pdf)]

Next steps checklist: 
- Confirm slot/timezone + attendees
- Share any existing latency/perf dashboards or SRE runbooks (if available)
- Let us know if you need an NDA/SSO questionnaire ahead of the call

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
